context: Request: the highest-value financing the firm has closed, to lead a financing-credentials pitch. Rubric: 1005-00001 (Nexford Industrial, $1.4B senior secured term loan B), plus a precision criterion (1041-00003 is within the permitted set).

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob; reviewer said partly (capped listing, visible matters unopened).

stages.stage: List matter folders
stages.note: Counts matter folders and shows the first and last 20 names; reviewer said yes.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction script for financing terms times out; patches it into four range runs, which first fail on a path-parsing error, then write hits to files and show only line counts.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Split from the declared scan span: find | grep over all file paths for financing and debt words, printing the 749-path list.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Extraction script pulls dollar amounts from the matched files, then a filter keeps closing/execution file names with nine-digit or billion amounts, first 100 lines; it settles on one acquisition's debt package as the largest. Reviewer said partly; flagged the file-name and amount filters and several unopened candidates by number.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Lists the leading candidate's files and reads its commitment letters, credit agreement, funds-flow memo and a draft closing report.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Split from the declared in-depth span: reads the first 35-60 lines of one agreement from each of five other candidate matters as comparators. Reviewer said partly; flagged that competitors were checked from 35-60 lines each and that many surfaced matters stayed unopened.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: declared: Search within a candidate matter's files; two scripts re-filter the store-wide amount inventory for financing files at or above the leading figure.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads the openings of four agreements from four high-amount matters; reviewer said partly and recommended opening one high-amount matter's financing folder.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Attempt 2. Lists that high-amount matter and reads its commitment letter, draft credit agreement, funds-flow memo, merger agreement and an email; an early write-stage start is rejected because this stage is still open.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes one acquisition's committed debt package as the largest closed financing, listing other screened matters as smaller comparators. Reviewer said partly; flagged comparators judged from snippets and unopened matters.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Adds a scope caveat, re-reads the response; a path-check script fails on the file location.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Attempt 2. Reruns the path check on the output file; all cited paths exist.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → List matter folders → Scan document text with an extraction script → Search file names for request keywords → Scan document text with an extraction script → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Scan document text with an extraction script → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → Write the response → Check or revise the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: It read the opening lines of the matter it needed only as a comparator and named a larger acquisition debt package as the highest-value closed financing.

first_error.why: It opened the executed credit agreement of the needed matter for only 35 lines (evidence seen at [50]-[57]) and ranked it below one acquisition's debt package, so the answer names another matter as the highest-value financing.
first_error.critic_note: Review [57] flagged that competing candidates were checked from 35-60 lines each and review [90] that comparators were judged from snippets; the agent instead followed up a different high-amount matter and only added a caveat.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob; reviewer said partly (capped listing).

stages.stage: List matter folders
stages.note: declared: List files in the document store (attempt 2); counts matter folders and shows a slice of the names. Reviewer said yes.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction script printing every passage with broad financing and debt terms; returns about 7.4M characters and the run ends.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → List matter folders → Scan document text with an extraction script

first_error.critic_note: The run ended inside the scan stage before its review; earlier reviews ([7], [13]) only warned about the capped listing.

stages.stage: List matter folders
stages.note: declared: List files in the document store (attempt 2); lists all 266 matter folder names. Reviewer said yes.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: find | grep over all file paths for financing, loan, credit and debt words; prints 669 paths. Reviewer said partly (overbroad pattern, output likely truncated).

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Attempt 2. Same search grouped into hit counts per matter.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide amount-extraction script times out; several patched range runs return zero files or fail before two ranges write hit files; greps those files for frequent and selected amounts. Reviewer said no; flagged the empty first range and narrow follow-up filters.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Attempt 2. Reruns the missing range over financing-named files and ranks amounts.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: declared: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth; reads executed agreements, commitment letters, a funds-flow memo and certificates from four candidate matters.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Split from the same declared span: reads the credit agreement further and the signature pages and closing deliverables of the matter it settled on. Reviewer said partly (closing rests on signature pages; unopened candidates).

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Attempt 2. Lists that matter's files, greps saved amount hits for five named matters, reads its funds-flow memo, closing certificate, post-closing summary and a closing letter, plus two documents from other matters.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Attempt 3. Store-wide scan for billion-scale figures by matter range; two of three hit files stop at the script's 1,000-line cap. Reviewer said partly (capped, noisy output).

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes one matter's term-loan facility as the highest closed financing it could substantiate, with closing documents and comparators.

stages.note: Re-reads the response and edits in a definition of value and a scope statement.

stages.note: Calls finish.

divergence: T1 overflowed the context with its first uncapped store-wide scan. T0 and T2 both surfaced the needed matter through file-name searches and amount scans and opened its executed credit agreement; they split at the reading stage. T2 read that matter's signature pages, funds-flow memo and closing certificate in depth and answered with its facility as the largest closed financing. T0 had already settled, from a filtered amount list, on one acquisition's larger debt package, read the needed matter's agreement for 35 lines as a comparator, and named the acquisition (under-inclusion). The reviews at the split were alike: both said partly; T0's review flagged the 35-60 line comparator reads, but the agent followed up a different high-amount matter instead.
